description: This file implements an API endpoint class `BuzzCommentAPI` for managing comments on Buzz shares within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting comments, including input validation, transaction management, and response formatting.

classes.name: BuzzCommentAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing buzz comments, including retrieving a specific comment, listing comments for a share, creating new comments, editing existing comments, and deleting comments. Implements `CrudEndpoint` interface, uses various traits for auxiliary functions, and handles validation and response formatting.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific comment based on shareId and commentId. Validates existence and returns the comment model in different formats based on 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all comments for a specific shareId, supports sorting and pagination, returns a collection of comment models.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new comment on a specified share. Starts a transaction, validates share existence, creates comment, updates share comment count, and commits the transaction.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing comment. Validates permissions and comment existence, updates text, and saves changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a comment. Validates permissions, deletes comment, updates share's comment count, and manages transactions.
